stem: At an eligible hospital ADD, a pharmacy technician trainee works under pharmacist direction and supervision but without direct pharmacist supervision. Which tasks may the trainee perform under the Massachusetts ADD stocking policy? Select all that apply.

choices.text: Override a clinical interaction warning before the dose is released
Transport and load pharmacist-verified Schedule III-VI stock using barcode or other electronic validation
Verify expiration dates and remove expired Schedule III-VI stock using electronic validation
Load an unverified Schedule IV bottle based only on the trainee's visual check
Transport and load Schedule II stock under the PTT pathway

explanation.core_reasoning: A PTT may perform defined pharmacist-verified Schedule III-VI inventory functions, not C-II or clinical judgment tasks.

choice_analysis.A: Clinical judgment is outside this inventory exception.
choice_analysis.B: This is an expressly permitted PTT function.
choice_analysis.E: PTT stocking is limited to III-VI.

related_facts: The activity remains under pharmacist direction and supervision.
explanation.mpje_trap: Equating absence of direct supervision with independent practice.

reasoning_steps: Identify trainee rather than licensed-technician privileges
Apply verification, schedule, and electronic-validation conditions
